NOTIFICATION SN-2025/01 — PAGE 2
Section 4. Eligibility Conditions:
Clause 4(a): The total annual income of the applicant's family from all sources shall not exceed ₹2,50,000 (Rupees Two Lakh Fifty Thousand only) for the preceding financial year.
Clause 4(b): The applicant must have secured at least 60% aggregate marks in the qualifying examination immediately preceding the current academic year.

NOTIFICATION SN-2025/01 — PAGE 3
Section 6. Mandatory Supporting Documents:
Clause 6(i): Valid Income Certificate issued by a competent revenue authority.
Clause 6(ii): Attested Marksheet of the qualifying examination.
Clause 6(iii): Photocopy of the applicant's active Bank Passbook showing account number and IFSC code.

NOTIFICATION SN-2025/01 — PAGE 4
Section 8. Application Timeline:
Clause 8: Complete online applications along with uploaded supporting documents must be submitted on or before 30 September 2026.

AMENDMENT SN-2026/07 — PAGE 1
In partial modification of Notification SN-2025/01:
Clause 2 (Amendment to Clause 4(a)): The family annual income ceiling is hereby enhanced from ₹2,50,000 to ₹3,00,000 (Rupees Three Lakh only) with effect from 20 September 2026.

AMENDMENT SN-2026/07 — PAGE 2
Clause 3 (Addition to Section 6): Applicants must additionally upload a current Enrolment Certificate issued by the Head of the Institution verifying active admission for 2026-27.
Clause 4 (Amendment to Section 8): The last date for submission of applications is extended from 30 September 2026 to 15 December 2026.

CIRCULAR STE-2026/02 — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Family annual income shall not exceed ₹4,50,000.
Clause 2(b): Applicant must have secured at least 75% aggregate marks in Class 12 or Diploma.
Clause 5: Last date to apply is 31 December 2026. Required documents: Marksheet, Income certificate, Enrolment certificate.

AICTE GUIDELINE PRG-2025/04 — PAGE 1
Clause 3(a): Total family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000.
Clause 3(b): Female candidates admitted to 1st year Degree/Diploma with minimum 65% qualifying marks are eligible.
Clause 6: Required documents: Income certificate, Marksheet, Bank passbook copy. Deadline: 31 December 2026.

AMENDMENT PRG-2026/09 — PAGE 1
Clause 1(a): Minimum qualifying marks for Pragati Scholarship are relaxed from 65% to 60% to widen technical participation.
Clause 1(b): Upload Bonafide / Institution Enrolment certificate countersigned by Principal.

MoE CIRCULAR NMMS-2026/01 — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Parental income ceiling is ₹3,50,000 per annum.
Clause 2(b): Student must have scored at least 55% marks in Class VIII annual examination.
Clause 4: Submit Income certificate, Marksheet, and Bank passbook copy before 30 November 2026.

NSP NOTICE CSSS-2026/03 — PAGE 1
Clause 3(a): Family annual income limit is ₹4,50,000.
Clause 3(b): Applicant must hold at least 80% marks (80th percentile equivalent) in Class XII.
Clause 7: Apply by 31 December 2026 with Marksheet, Income certificate, Bank passbook copy.

G.O.Ms.No. 42/2026 (RTF-06) — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
Clause 2(b): Minimum 50% qualifying marks and 75% semester attendance required.
Clause 5: Upload Income certificate, Marksheet, Bank passbook copy by 15 January 2027.

CIRCULAR HST-2025/05 — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Family income limit ₹3,00,000.
Clause 2(b): Qualifying exam marks ≥ 60%.
Clause 4: Required documents: Income certificate, Marksheet, Hostel Warden certificate. Last date: 10 November 2026.

AMENDMENT HST-2026/04 — PAGE 1
Clause 1: Due to delayed university hostel allotments, the deadline for Hostel Mess Maintenance Grant (HST-07) is extended from 10 November 2026 to 20 January 2027.

MSDE CIRCULAR SKL-2026/08 — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Household annual income up to ₹6,00,000.
Clause 2(b): Minimum 45% prior academic score.
Clause 5: Upload Marksheet, Bank passbook copy, and NSQF Assessment Certificate by 28 February 2027.

AICTE NOTIFICATION SKM-2026/02 — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Family annual income must not exceed ₹8,00,000.
Clause 2(b): Minimum 50% qualifying marks in Class 12/Diploma for Divyangjan candidates with >=40% benchmark disability.
Clause 5: Upload UDID Disability certificate, Income certificate, Marksheet, and Bank passbook copy by 31 Dec 2026.

G.O.Rt.No. 118/2025 (MED-10) — PAGE 1
Clause 3(a): Family annual income limit ₹3,00,000.
Clause 3(b): Applicant must hold minimum 60% marks in qualifying science/nursing exam.
Clause 6: Required documents: Income certificate, Marksheet, Enrolment certificate, Bank passbook copy. Deadline: 20 Dec 2026.

AMENDMENT MED-2026/14 — PAGE 1
Clause 1: Considering revised clinical fee structures, the annual income ceiling for Medical, Nursing & Allied Health Stipend (MED-10) is enhanced from ₹3,00,000 to ₹4,00,000 effective 15 Nov 2026.

CIRCULAR AGR-2025/09 — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Annual family income ceiling is ₹2,50,000.
Clause 2(b): Minimum 55% aggregate in Intermediate BiPC / Agricultural Polytechnic.
Clause 5: Submit Income certificate, Marksheet, and Bank passbook copy before 15 Jan 2027.

CORRIGENDUM AGR-2026/12 — PAGE 1
Clause 2: Parental annual income threshold for Rythu Vidya Agricultural Grant (AGR-11) is revised upward from ₹2,50,000 to ₹3,50,000 to include marginal tenant farmer families.

MoMA NOTIFICATION MCM-2026/05 — PAGE 1
Clause 3(a): Family annual income shall not exceed ₹2,50,000.
Clause 3(b): Minimum 50% marks in previous final examination.
Clause 6: Upload Income certificate, Marksheet, Bank passbook copy, Enrolment certificate by 31 Jan 2027.

MoTA GUIDELINE TRB-2026/06 — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Family income ceiling ₹6,00,000.
Clause 2(b): Minimum 50% qualifying marks required.
Clause 4: Required documents: Caste / Community certificate, Income certificate, Marksheet, Bank passbook copy. Deadline: 31 Jan 2027.

SCST CIRCULAR RES-2026/03 — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Household income limit ₹8,00,000.
Clause 2(b): Minimum 70% UG/PG marks required.
Clause 5: Upload Marksheet, Enrolment certificate, Bank passbook copy by 31 Jan 2027.

AMENDMENT RES-2026/10 — PAGE 1
Clause 1: Application deadline for Young Innovator Research Fellowship (RES-14) is extended from 31 Jan 2027 to 15 Mar 2027.

KSB CIRCULAR PMSS-2026/04 — PAGE 1
Clause 3(a): Family annual income ceiling ₹10,00,000.
Clause 3(b): Applicant must secure at least 60% in Minimum Educational Qualification (MEQ).
Clause 6: Upload Marksheet, Bonafide certificate, Bank passbook copy by 15 Feb 2027.

SPORTS AUTHORITY SPR-2026/07 — PAGE 1
Clause 2(a): Family annual income must not exceed ₹6,00,000.
Clause 2(b): Student athletes must hold at least 50% academic aggregate.
Clause 5: Submit Sports Merit certificate, Marksheet, Bank passbook copy by 20 Feb 2027.

procedure_steps.title_te: ప్రధానోపాధ్యాయుని ధృవీకరణతో 30 నవంబర్ 2026 లోపు సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Submit claim on National Scholarship Portal and have the School Headmaster verify attendance & enrolment.
procedure_steps.description_te: NSP పోర్టల్‌లో సమర్పించి పాఠశాల ప్రధానోపాధ్యాయుని ఆన్‌లైన్ ధృవీకరణ పూర్తి చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify Class XII ≥ 80% score & 80th percentile board merit
procedure_steps.title_te: 12వ తరగతి ≥ 80% మార్కులు & బోర్డ్ మెరిట్‌ను నిర్ధారించండి
procedure_steps.description: Check Class XII Marksheet confirms ≥ 80% aggregate and your name appears on the state/CBSE merit list.
procedure_steps.description_te: 12వ తరగతి మార్కుల జాబితాలో కనీసం 80% మార్కులు ఉన్నాయని నిర్ధారించండి.

procedure_steps.title: Gather Income Certificate (≤ ₹4.5L) & Bank Passbook Copy
procedure_steps.title_te: ఆదాయ పత్రం (≤ ₹4.5L) & బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ కాపీని సేకరించండి
procedure_steps.description: Verify family annual income ≤ ₹4,50,000 and ensure Bank passbook IFSC matches NSP profile.
procedure_steps.description_te: కుటుంబ ఆదాయం ≤ ₹4,50,000 మరియు బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ వివరాలు సరిపోలేలా చూసుకోండి.

procedure_steps.title: Complete NSP OTR & submit before 31 Dec 2026
procedure_steps.title_te: NSP OTR పూర్తి చేసి 31 డిసెంబర్ 2026 లోపు సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Upload Marksheet, Income certificate, and Bank passbook copy on NSP and track college INO approval.
procedure_steps.description_te: మార్కుల జాబితా, ఆదాయ పత్రం అప్‌లోడ్ చేసి కళాశాల ఆమోదం పొందండి.

procedure_steps.title: Check ≥ 50% qualifying marks & 75% semester attendance
procedure_steps.title_te: ≥ 50% అర్హత మార్కులు & 75% హాజరును నిర్ధారించండి
procedure_steps.description: Confirm prior examination Marksheet ≥ 50% and institutional attendance register reflects ≥ 75%.
procedure_steps.description_te: మునుపటి పరీక్ష మార్కుల జాబితా ≥ 50% మరియు 75% హాజరు ఉన్నాయని నిర్ధారించండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5L) & Student-Mother Joint Account
procedure_steps.title_te: ఆదాయ పత్రం (≤ ₹2.5L) & జాయింట్ బ్యాంక్ ఖాతా తనిఖీ
procedure_steps.description: Ensure MeeSeva Income certificate ≤ ₹2,50,000 and active joint Bank passbook copy is ready.
procedure_steps.description_te: మీసేవ ఆదాయ పత్రం (≤ ₹2.5L) మరియు జాయింట్ బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ సిద్ధం చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Complete biometric e-KYC & submit ePass before 15 Jan 2027
procedure_steps.title_te: బయోమెట్రిక్ e-KYC పూర్తి చేసి 15 జనవరి 2027 లోపు సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Verify Aadhaar biometric authentication at college/MeeSeva and submit quarterly reimbursement packet.
procedure_steps.description_te: బయోమెట్రిక్ ఆధార్ ధృవీకరణ పూర్తి చేసి ePass పోర్టల్‌లో సమర్పించండి.

procedure_steps.title: Obtain Hostel Warden Residence Certificate & Attendance Proof
procedure_steps.title_te: హాస్టల్ వార్డెన్ నివాస ధృవీకరణ పత్రాన్ని పొందండి
procedure_steps.description: Get signed Hostel Warden certificate confirming boarding duration and mess fee schedule.
procedure_steps.description_te: గుర్తింపు పొందిన హాస్టల్ వార్డెన్ సంతకం చేసిన నివాస ధృవీకరణ పత్రాన్ని పొందండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify Income ≤ ₹3,00,000 & Qualifying Marksheet ≥ 60%
procedure_steps.description: Check revenue Income certificate and academic Marksheet for consistent applicant details.
procedure_steps.description_te: ఆదాయ ధృవీకరణ పత్రం మరియు మార్కుల జాబితాలో పేరు వివరాలు సరిపోలాయో చూసుకోండి.

procedure_steps.title: Submit Hostel Mess Subsidy claim on Collegiate Portal
procedure_steps.title_te: కాలేజీ పోర్టల్‌లో హాస్టల్ మెస్ సబ్సిడీ దరఖాస్తు సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Upload Income cert, Marksheet, and Warden proof for Welfare Officer verification and DBT payout.
procedure_steps.description_te: ఆదాయ పత్రం, మార్కుల జాబితా మరియు వార్డెన్ ధృవీకరణ అప్‌లోడ్ చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Complete NSQF Level 4+ Skill Track & Download Assessment Cert
procedure_steps.title_te: NSQF స్థాయి 4+ నైపుణ్య శిక్షణ & సర్టిఫికెట్ పొందండి
procedure_steps.description: Obtain verified Skill India / Sector Skill Council NSQF Assessment Certificate.
procedure_steps.description_te: స్కిల్ ఇండియా గుర్తింపు పొందిన NSQF అసెస్‌మెంట్ సర్టిఫికెట్ డౌన్‌లోడ్ చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify ≥ 45% prior marks & household income ≤ ₹6,00,000
procedure_steps.title_te: కనీసం 45% మార్కులు & ₹6,00,000 ఆదాయ పరిమితి తనిఖీ
procedure_steps.description: Ensure prior Marksheet ≥ 45% and NPCI Aadhaar-seeded Bank passbook copy are uploaded to Vault.
procedure_steps.description_te: మునుపటి మార్కుల జాబితా మరియు బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ కాపీని సిద్ధం చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Submit Skill Certification Stipend Claim by 28 Feb 2027
procedure_steps.title_te: 28 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027 లోపు స్కిల్ స్టైపెండ్ క్లెయిమ్ సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Submit claim on Skill India portal for one-time ₹10,000 certification reward & toolkit DBT.
procedure_steps.description_te: స్కిల్ ఇండియా పోర్టల్‌లో దరఖాస్తు సమర్పించి ₹10,000 స్టైపెండ్ పొందండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify UDID benchmark disability (>=40%) & AICTE admission
procedure_steps.title_te: UDID వైకల్య ధృవీకరణ (>=40%) & AICTE ప్రవేశాన్ని నిర్ధారించండి
procedure_steps.description: Confirm your UDID Disability certificate shows >=40% benchmark disability and college is AICTE-approved.
procedure_steps.description_te: మీ UDID నంబర్ (>=40%) మరియు AICTE కళాశాల ప్రవేశాన్ని నిర్ధారించుకోండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify ≥ 50% qualifying marks & Income ≤ ₹8,00,000
procedure_steps.description: Prepare revenue Income certificate, qualifying Marksheet, and NPCI-linked Bank passbook copy.
procedure_steps.description_te: ఆదాయ ధృవీకరణ పత్రం, మార్కుల జాబితా మరియు బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ కాపీని సిద్ధం చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Submit Saksham Divyangjan claim on NSP before 31 Dec 2026
procedure_steps.title_te: 31 డిసెంబర్ 2026 లోపు NSP లో సక్షమ్ దరఖాస్తు సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Complete NSP OTR registration, upload scanned UDID & Income certificates, and route to Institute Nodal Officer.
procedure_steps.description_te: NSP పోర్టల్‌లో OTR పూర్తి చేసి UDID మరియు ఆదాయ పత్రాలను అప్‌లోడ్ చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Confirm >=60% science marks & clinical college enrolment
procedure_steps.title_te: >=60% మార్కులు & క్లినికల్ కళాశాల నమోదును నిర్ధారించండి
procedure_steps.description: Obtain Dean/Principal countersigned clinical Enrolment certificate along with Science/Nursing Marksheet.
procedure_steps.description_te: కళాశాల ప్రిన్సిపాల్ సంతకం చేసిన క్లినికల్ నమోదు ధృవీకరణ పత్రం & మార్కుల జాబితాను పొందండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify family Income Certificate (≤ ₹3L / pending ₹4L)
procedure_steps.title_te: కుటుంబ ఆదాయ ధృవీకరణ పత్రాన్ని (≤ ₹3L) నిర్ధారించండి
procedure_steps.description: Ensure MeeSeva Income certificate and DBT-active Bank passbook copy have matching applicant names.
procedure_steps.description_te: ఆదాయ ధృవీకరణ పత్రం మరియు బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్‌లో పేరు సరిపోలాయో తనిఖీ చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Submit Medical Stipend dossier on DME portal by 20 Dec 2026
procedure_steps.title_te: 20 డిసెంబర్ 2026 లోపు DME పోర్టల్‌లో సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Upload all verified clinical & income documents before deadline for DME officer scrutiny and DBT stipend release.
procedure_steps.description_te: గడువులోపు DME పోర్టల్‌లో దరఖాస్తును సమర్పించి స్టైపెండ్ ఆమోదం పొందండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify BiPC/Agri marks (>=55%) & Agricultural University admission
procedure_steps.title_te: BiPC/అగ్రి మార్కులు (>=55%) & వ్యవసాయ విశ్వవిద్యాలయ ప్రవేశం నిర్ధారించండి
procedure_steps.description: Confirm admission into B.Sc Agriculture/Horticulture/Veterinary with qualifying Marksheet.
procedure_steps.description_te: వ్యవసాయ లేదా పశువైద్య డిగ్రీ ప్రవేశం మరియు మార్కుల జాబితాను నిర్ధారించండి.

procedure_steps.title: Gather farmer family Income Certificate & DBT Bank Passbook
procedure_steps.title_te: రైతు కుటుంబ ఆదాయ పత్రం & బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ సిద్ధం చేయండి
procedure_steps.description: Attach revenue Income certificate (≤ ₹2.5L baseline; ₹3.5L corrigendum pending) and Bank passbook copy.
procedure_steps.description_te: రెవెన్యూ ఆదాయ ధృవీకరణ పత్రం మరియు DBT బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ కాపీని జతచేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Submit Rythu Vidya application before 15 Jan 2027
procedure_steps.title_te: 15 జనవరి 2027 లోపు రైతు విద్య దరఖాస్తు సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Complete ICAR/State Agricultural University portal verification for ₹24,000 annual grant + practicum claim.
procedure_steps.description_te: యూనివర్సిటీ పోర్టల్‌లో దరఖాస్తు పూర్తి చేసి ₹24,000 గ్రాంట్ పొందండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify ≥ 50% qualifying marks & professional degree enrolment
procedure_steps.title_te: ≥ 50% మార్కులు & ప్రొఫెషనల్ కోర్సు ప్రవేశాన్ని నిర్ధారించండి
procedure_steps.description: Confirm Engineering/Architecture/Management admission and previous final Marksheet ≥ 50%.
procedure_steps.description_te: ప్రొఫెషనల్ కోర్సు ప్రవేశం మరియు కనీసం 50% మార్కులను నిర్ధారించండి.

procedure_steps.title: Validate Income Certificate ≤ ₹2,50,000 & Bank Passbook
procedure_steps.title_te: ఆదాయ పత్రం ≤ ₹2,50,000 & బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ తనిఖీ చేయండి
procedure_steps.description: Keep parent Income certificate, Bank passbook copy, and minority community declaration ready.
procedure_steps.description_te: ఆదాయ ధృవీకరణ పత్రం, బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ మరియు మైనారిటీ ధృవీకరణను సిద్ధం చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Upload MCM packet on NSP before 31 Jan 2027
procedure_steps.title_te: 31 జనవరి 2027 లోపు NSP లో MCM దరఖాస్తు అప్‌లోడ్ చేయండి
procedure_steps.description: Submit online claim on National Scholarship Portal and verify institutional forwarding.
procedure_steps.description_te: NSP పోర్టల్‌లో అప్‌లోడ్ చేసి కళాశాల ఆమోదాన్ని నిర్ధారించండి.

procedure_steps.title: Attach verified ST Caste / Community Certificate & ≥ 50% Marks
procedure_steps.title_te: ST కుల ధృవీకరణ పత్రం & ≥ 50% మార్కులు జతచేయండి
procedure_steps.description: Obtain Revenue-signed ST Caste / Community certificate and upload qualifying Marksheet.
procedure_steps.description_te: రెవెన్యూ అధికారి సంతకం చేసిన ST కుల పత్రం మరియు మార్కుల జాబితాను జతచేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify Income ≤ ₹6,00,000 & Institutional Fee Demand Note
procedure_steps.title_te: ఆదాయం ≤ ₹6,00,000 & కళాశాల ఫీజు రశీదును తనిఖీ చేయండి
procedure_steps.description: Ensure Income certificate ≤ ₹6,00,000, Enrolment proof, and DBT Bank passbook copy are saved in Vault.
procedure_steps.description_te: ఆదాయ పత్రం (≤ ₹6L), నమోదు పత్రం మరియు బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ కాపీని సిద్ధం చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Submit Tribal Higher Education Aid packet before 31 Jan 2027
procedure_steps.title_te: 31 జనవరి 2027 లోపు గిరిజన ఉన్నత విద్య దరఖాస్తు సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Submit through Ministry of Tribal Affairs / ITDA portal for full tuition, living stipend & laptop aid.
procedure_steps.description_te: గిరిజన సంక్షేమ పోర్టల్‌లో సమర్పించి పూర్తి ట్యూషన్ & భృతి పొందండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify >=70% UG/PG marks & PG/Ph.D Research Enrolment
procedure_steps.title_te: >=70% UG/PG మార్కులు & యూనివర్సిటీ రీసెర్చ్ నమోదు నిర్ధారించండి
procedure_steps.description: Confirm ≥ 70% aggregate on Marksheet and obtain University Registrar research Enrolment certificate.
procedure_steps.description_te: కనీసం 70% మార్కుల జాబితా మరియు విశ్వవిద్యాలయ పరిశోధన నమోదు పత్రాన్ని పొందండి.

procedure_steps.title: Prepare Household Income Proof (≤ ₹8L) & DBT Bank Passbook
procedure_steps.title_te: ఆదాయ పత్రం (≤ ₹8L) & బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ సిద్ధం చేయండి
procedure_steps.description: Keep Bank passbook copy and clean-energy/agri-tech/civic-AI research synopsis ready.
procedure_steps.description_te: బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ కాపీ మరియు పరిశోధన సారాంశ పత్రాన్ని సిద్ధం చేయండి.

procedure_steps.title: Submit Research Fellowship Proposal before deadline
procedure_steps.title_te: గడువులోపు రీసెర్చ్ ఫెలోషిప్ ప్రతిపాదన సమర్పించండి
procedure_steps.description: Submit on State Science & Innovation portal (31 Jan 2027 baseline; 15 Mar 2027 extension queued in RuleWeaver).
procedure_steps.description_te: రాష్ట్ర సైన్స్ & ఇన్నోవేషన్ పోర్టల్‌లో దరఖాస్తును సమర్పించండి.

procedure_steps.title: Verify >=60% MEQ Marksheet & Bonafide Student Certificate
procedure_steps.title_te: >=60% మార్కుల జాబితా & బోనఫైడ్ ధృవీకరణను తనిఖీ చేయండి
procedure_steps.description: Obtain Principal-signed Bonafide certificate and verify ≥ 60% Minimum Educational Qualification Marksheet.
procedure_steps.description_te: ప్రిన్సిపాల్ సంతకం చేసిన బోనఫైడ్ పత్రం మరియు ≥ 60% మార్కుల జాబితాను పొందండి.

procedure_steps.title: Attach Ex-Servicemen/Police Dependency & Bank Passbook Copy
procedure_steps.title_te: సైనిక/పోలీసు సర్వీస్ పత్రం & బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ జతచేయండి

faqs.question: How do I update my district, income, or notification interests in NiyamSetu?
faqs.answer: Open Profile & Document Vault from the citizen sidebar. You can update your residential district, educational track, DBT bank last-4 digits, and select topics under "My Interests & Daily Updates" plus notification preferences anytime.
faqs.official_reference: Citizen Profile & Vault · NiyamSetu Governance Standard

faqs.question: Can I sign in with Google without losing my saved document vault?
faqs.answer: Yes. Firebase Google Sign-In synchronizes your verified email with your persistent citizen dossier and Firestore cloud bookmarks so your saved schemes and documents remain intact.

faqs.question: Why does NiyamSetu show "New Rule" vs "Revised Rule" on scheme cards?
faqs.answer: New Rules are v1 statutory clauses from newly introduced circulars. Revised Rules (v2+) represent official amendments approved by human officers—such as raising an annual family income ceiling or extending a closing date.
faqs.official_reference: NiyamSetu RuleWeaver & Policy Ripple Audit Spec

faqs.question: Where do the official circulars and dates shown on scheme pages come from?
faqs.answer: Every scheme links directly to its monitored government notification (e.g., NSP, Telangana ePass, AICTE, Skill India, DST), displaying document numbers, effective dates, and source page/clause citations.

faqs.question: Does a "Likely Eligible" result guarantee scholarship sanction?
faqs.answer: No. Deterministic eligibility compares your self-declared profile and Vault certificates against active circular rules to help you prepare. Final legal sanction always rests with the designated District Welfare Officer and official portal.

faqs.question: How does the What-If Eligibility Simulator help me?
faqs.answer: The What-If Simulator lets you test how changes—such as updated family income, latest semester marks percentage, or hostel residency—affect your deterministic eligibility across all 16 verified schemes before applying.

faqs.question: Does FormSathi AI submit my application to the government portal automatically?
faqs.answer: No. FormSathi maps your saved profile and Vault documents, highlights missing items, and lets you review every field. You explicitly approve the packet, visit the official government portal for OTP/CAPTCHA submission, and record your confirmation reference here.

faqs.question: What happens if an application rule changes after I started a draft?
faqs.answer: NiyamSetu checks active RuleWeaver v2+ revisions against your open drafts and bookmarked schemes, surfacing a Government Change Alert on your Dashboard so you can update documents before portal cutoff.

faqs.question: What if my Income Certificate is missing a barcode or is close to expiring?
faqs.answer: Your Document Vault automatically flags expired certificates or those expiring within 30 days and alerts you if a certificate number is blank. Obtain a renewed FY certificate from MeeSeva / Tahsildar before final portal lock.
faqs.official_reference: Vault Expiry & Metadata Checker · Revenue Dept Rules

faqs.question: Do I have to re-upload Aadhaar, Marksheet, and Bank Passbook for every scheme?
faqs.answer: No. Upload or quick-memorize them once inside your Document Vault (marked Reusable Across All Schemes). FormSathi and the All-16 Eligibility Engine reuse them automatically wherever permitted.

faqs.question: Why does the Application Delay Assistant separate Verified vs Possible vs Unknown reasons?
faqs.answer: To stay strictly truthful, NiyamSetu never guesses why an external portal is slow. Verified reasons come from your recorded missing items or SLA elapsed days; Possible explanations note typical workflow queues (like Institute Bonafide or PFMS bank check); Unknown factors explicitly state external back-office queues that only the department can confirm.

faqs.question: When should I escalate a delayed application into an official complaint?
faqs.answer: Once your submitted application exceeds the scheme’s officially published processing SLA (for example, 30 days for ePass RTF-06 or 45 days for NSP PM-01) with no status movement, use the "Escalate via Complaint" button inside Delay Intelligence or CPGRAMS.
faqs.official_reference: Published Processing SLAs & CPGRAMS Escalation Guide

faqs.question: What is the difference between NiyamSetu Tracked vs External Portal Logged complaints?
faqs.answer: NiyamSetu Tracked complaints are routed directly to partnered Organization/Government desks inside this platform with a live NSM-CMP reference number and status timeline. External Manual logs help you keep reminders and reference numbers (like CPGRAMS or bank tickets) you filed outside NiyamSetu.

faqs.question: Can I attach proof when raising a complaint about a bank DBT failure or college delay?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Raise a Complaint drawer accepts supporting attachment metadata (PDF/image filenames and descriptions) and generates a printable/trackable timeline with department updates.

faqs.question: What information is inside my Emergency QR Pass?
faqs.answer: Your Emergency QR Pass contains ONLY an opaque verification token (e.g. NIYAMSETU-EMR-TOKEN:QR-EMR-...). It never stores your blood group, allergies, or phone number in plain QR text. Only authenticated hospital responders scanning the token trigger an audited lookup revealing strictly life-safety medical details.
faqs.official_reference: Emergency Responder Token & Minimum-Data Access Policy

faqs.question: What if I do not know my blood group yet?
faqs.answer: You can select "UNKNOWN (Pending Lab Confirmation)" in your Emergency Medical Info card. Hospital responder views explicitly enforce safe UNKNOWN clinical cross-match protocols instead of guessing.

faqs.question: Which nearby facilities can I locate on the Services Map?
faqs.answer: You can search Hospitals & Medical Boards, Banks & DBT Desks, Tahsildar / Social Welfare Government Offices, and MeeSeva / CSC Citizen Centers using live Google Maps Platform search around your GPS or chosen district.

faqs.question: Does NiyamSetu store passwords, OTPs, ATM PINs, or full bank account numbers?
faqs.answer: Never. Both frontend validation and backend security policies strictly reject any field containing password, passcode, OTP, PIN, or CVV. Only bank name, IFSC, and last 4 account digits are kept to help you prepare DBT forms.

faqs.question: Who can see my personal documents and hospital emergency lookups?
faqs.answer: Only you own your Document Vault and Applications. Partner Organizations (Hospital, Bank, College) only see tasks assigned to their specific sector, and every hospital emergency lookup writes an immutable audit log visible to you and Main Government oversight.
faqs.official_reference: Role-Based Access Control & Immutable Audit Log
